bounded_hypothesis: Among confidence-qualified sequence-dark representative protein models (>=100 aa, mean pLDDT >=0.70; one representative per fold cluster) with low whole-chain PDB structural similarity (qTM_wc < 0.5), physical cropping and de novo Foldseek alignment of outcome-independent confident structural regions (>=50 aa, 15-aa rolling-window smoothed pLDDT >=0.70, bridging <=5 aa dips with mean pLDDT >=0.55) against PDB (pdb_20260730/foldseek_pdb) recovers reference-conditional structural matches (qTM_crop >= 0.5) at a higher parent-model-level rate in candidates with whole-chain local hits (K_local_pdb, and overall K_local_all) than in candidates lacking local hits (K_dual_none), when evaluated symmetrically across sequence-identity exclusion tiers against internal fold-matched dark comparators (Q \ K) and PDB positive controls.

prior_critical_findings.evidence: V3 re-ran Foldseek easy-search with --max-seqs 1000 for both whole-chain (300 models) and cropped-region (413 regions) queries (Slurm job 53706771), reducing POST_EXCLUSION_EMPTY among control regions from 17/103 (Tier 2), 22/103 (Tier 3), and 27/103 (Tier 4) in V2 (--max-seqs 50) to 0/103 (0.00%) across all five tiers (Tiers 0-4) and rescuing +19, +23, and +31 control regions at Tiers 2, 3, and 4 (unconditional control region match rates 99.03% at Tiers 1-2 and 98.06% at Tiers 3-4; model-level 98.67% [74/75] and 97.33% [73/75]). Scripts explicitly separate POST_EXCLUSION_EMPTY from PERSISTENT_LOW_SCORE, track hit-list saturation (total_hits_raw >= 1000: 8/75 control whole chains and 8/103 control regions, 0 candidates), and document that a finite cap (1000) mitigates but does not theoretically eliminate homology-saturation censoring.

V3 completed physical region cropping across all N=5,851 parent models (Slurm job 53704591; results/v3_full5851_cropped_regions_manifest.tsv, 7,784 rows), yielding 7,773 cropped regions across 5,690 eligible models and an exact finite-population census of 161 (2.75%) NO_CONFIDENT_REGION models (37/849 [4.36%] K_local_pdb, 3/87 [3.45%] K_local_afdb_only, 7/95 [7.37%] K_dual_none, 70/1,107 [6.32%] Q_not_K_pdb, 31/700 [4.43%] Q_not_K_afdb_only, 13/3,013 [0.43%] Controls). In the n=300 pilot, NO_CONFIDENT_REGION (11 models: 3 K_local_pdb, 4 K_dual_none, 4 Q_not_K_pdb) is strictly separated from Foldseek RAW_ZERO_RETRIEVAL (12 models: 1 K_local_pdb, 10 K_dual_none, 1 Control) across all tables and JSON summaries.

V3 searched both whole-chain models (n=300, v3_wc_pdb_hits.raw.tsv, 115,916 rows) and cropped regions (413 regions, v3_crop_pdb_hits.raw.tsv, 129,914 rows) in the same run (Slurm job 53706771) with identical Foldseek parameters (--alignment-type 1 -e 10 -s 9.5 --max-seqs 1000) and 21-column output schemas, applied Tiers 0-4 symmetrically to both, partitioned PDB-consistent vs AFDB-only baseline strata (K_local_pdb vs K_local_afdb_only; Q_not_K_pdb vs Q_not_K_afdb_only), and tracked the 10-state within-model transition matrix (trans_t0..t4). In K_local_pdb (n=90), 9/90 models match on the whole chain at --max-seqs 1000 (8 retained in crops, 1 NO_CONFIDENT_REGION) and 67/81 (82.72% unweighted; 83.04% H-T weighted, 95% CI [74.06%, 92.02%]) of same-run whole-chain unmatched models recover a cropped match, vs 18/50 (36.00% unweighted and H-T weighted, 95% CI [26.75%, 45.25%]) in K_dual_none (+47.04 pp H-T contrast, FPC z=7.15, p=8.53e-13; Fisher exact p=7.46e-8). In Q_not_K_pdb (n=55), 51/51 (100.0%) region-eligible models retain their match in crops.

V3 provided an empirical 16-CPU scaling benchmark from Slurm job 53704591 showing why full-cohort --max-seqs 1000 TM-align across 5,851 whole chains + 7,773 cropped regions (~1.35e7 3D superpositions) requires ~84.5 min for whole chains alone and ~183 min (3.05 h) combined on 16 CPUs, exceeding the <=16 CPU, <=64 GB, <=1 h single-job allocation cap. V3 retained the exact N=5,851 region-eligibility census and implemented Horvitz-Thompson / Hajek inverse-probability design-weighted estimators with finite-population-corrected (FPC) standard errors across all 7 sampling design strata (sum of weights = 5,851.00; K_local_all weights 5.12, 17.40, 9.24, 5.68 summing to 936.00).

V3 parsed exact aligned residue pairs (M operations from Foldseek cigar strings) across all 115,916 whole-chain and 129,914 cropped hit rows, verified cigar_M_count == qspan + tspan - alnlen on 100% of rows, and reported aligned_pair_qcov (82.79% in K_local_pdb, 74.86% in K_dual_none, 89.53% in Q_not_K_pdb, 98.06% in Controls) separately from qspan_cov (92.75%, 88.77%, 96.14%, 99.55%). Primary cross-stratum inference is conducted at the parent-model level across all tiers; the 3,013-control self-hit exclusion test uses exact paired McNemar binomial p = 4.55e-13 (b=0, c=42); and top-hit sequence identity is computed strictly over retrieved queries while enumerating all 4 candidate regions (417 cropped hit rows, 114 whole-chain rows) with fident >= 20%.
